scope: Native long-mode LFENCE/MFENCE/SFENCE with a dedicated memory synchronization callback, full ARM64 DSB SY + ISB barriers, isolated retirement boundaries, and SSE/SSE2 feature gates.
validation: 130 tests in four suites passed. Covers both JIT tiers, owner synchronization after a store, faults before/after fences, exact architectural state, disabled features, absent memory authority, malformed replayable IR, and existing decode/canonical/system-instruction boundaries.
encodingValidation: Apple clang arm64 assembler and otool confirmed DSB SY d5033f9f, ISB d5033fdf, MOV x24,x5 aa0503f8.
limitation: Exact changed sources tested in an isolated qualification checkout; not all-HEAD or production boot qualification. Full barriers conservatively order all three fence kinds. No measured boot speedup claimed.
